//: Copy to appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) OR export the equivalent environment variables.
//_env: Environment-variable form replaces ':' with '__', e.g. JwtSettings__SecretKey, Smtp__Password.

JwtSettings.//: Required in Production. Use a long random value; never reuse the one that used to be committed.

Smtp.//: Leave Enabled=false unless you really want this machine to send live email.

GoogleDrive.//: Required in Production when Enabled=true and AuthMode=OAuthUser.
